title: Intermediate Backend Engineer , Security Factory
text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in their code by contributing to the static analysis engine that finds them.

Your work spans both the engine and the tools we use to evaluate it. You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You'll also build and apply tooling to test its findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, measuring both false positives and missed vulnerabilities.

We build the engine with artificial intelligence (AI) agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. You'll implement component specifications within the team's architecture, working with engineers and AI agents. Good judgment about when to trust agent output, and when to bring it to human review, is central to the role.

What you'll do

Extend the program model, including parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis, to support new languages and frameworks.

Build and apply AI-assisted tooling to implement, review, and validate engine changes and findings, in collaboration with the team's technical leadership. Measure detection quality against known vulnerabilities, judging changes primarily on false positive and false negative rates.

Develop static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), along with test fixtures that demonstrate they work.

Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.

Improve the harness, agent instructions, and skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy. Use separate coding and reviewing agents, performance checks, application programming interface (API) checks, and dependency checks, and escalate risky changes to human review.

Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity, and identify and address technical debt that slows the team down.

Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.

Participate in on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.

title: Devops Engineer (1-3 years)
text:
Company Description

Job Description
Engineer, Chennai 
Our Technology teams are focused on supporting and modernizing enterprise applications through automation, DevOps best practices, and continuous improvement. The DevOps team manages these platforms while adopting modern engineering practices including GitHub Actions, Infrastructure Automation, Cloud technologies, and AI-assisted development tools. 

As a Junior DevOps Engineer, you'll work alongside experienced engineers to support application deployments, CI/CD pipelines, operational excellence, and platform reliability. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience across DevOps, Linux administration, security, cloud technologies, and AI-enabled engineering practices while contributing to critical business platforms.  
Responsibilities 
Support CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for application build, test, deployment, and release activities. 
Assist in managing and supporting applications hosted in on-premise and hybrid environments. 
Perform log analysis, shell scripting, service monitoring, and troubleshooting. 
Assist with automation initiatives to improve deployment efficiency, operational stability, and repeatability. 
Follow DevSecOps practices including secure handling of credentials, access management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements. 
Monitor application and infrastructure health, investigate alerts, and support root cause analysis activities. 
Utilize AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Copilot to improve productivity, documentation, automation, and troubleshooting. 
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, database, security, and business teams while continuously building technical expertise
Qualifications
Must Have: At least 1-3 years of experience in DevOps in on-prem/cloud environment or a related technical role. 
Strong understanding of CI/CD concepts and source control systems such as GitHub. 
Hands-on with GitHub Actions or other CICD tools. 
Experience in container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes. 
Basic Linux/Unix knowledge including commands, file systems, process management, and shell scripting. 
Understanding of DevOps principles, software delivery lifecycle, and release management concepts. 
Exposure to Oracle databases or relational database concepts and SQL fundamentals. 
Basic understanding of security best practices, including access controls, password management, and secure software delivery. 
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
Demonstrated ability to work effectively within Agile/Scrum teams. 
Nice to Have: Exposure to cloud platforms and Infrastructure as Code concepts (Terraform, Ansible, etc.). 
Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools. 
Experience using AI-enabled developer tools such as GitHub Copilot. 
Strong learning mindset and eagerness to adopt new technologies.

title: Software Engineer 1
text:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity:

At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers observability tools across heterogeneous technologies and distributed systems, enabling engineering teams to identify, understand, and tackle issues, analyze performance, and get the most out of their software and infrastructure.

You will be part of the Infra+ Platform & Synthetics team, which owns critical backend platforms including Scheduler, Serverless, and Synthetics. Operating at massive scale, our modern stack leverages Java, Node.js, Go, Kubernetes, Kafka, and GraphQL, paired with React on the frontend. As a Backend-Focused Full Stack Engineer, your primary mission will be architecting resilient, high-throughput microservices and data pipelines, while building clean, intuitive web interfaces when full-stack delivery is required.

This high-impact engineering position offers the opportunity to own distributed backend systems processing massive telemetry streams alongside companion management interfaces. We are looking for a motivated engineer ready to tackle complex scalability challenges. We look forward to talking with you!

What you'll do:

Architect, implement, test, and scale resilient microservices and distributed backend systems using Java, Node.js, or Go.

Design robust data models, efficient schemas, and high-performance APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) capable of handling high-concurrency workloads.

Implement asynchronous messaging, distributed caching, and stream-processing patterns (e.g., Kafka) to process high-volume telemetry and synthetic execution data.

Own the full lifecycle of your services—from writing clean, tested code to setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications, and deploying to Kubernetes-managed cloud infrastructure.

Create automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and telemetry instrumentation to ensure services are fault-tolerant, observable, and performant.

Work directly within a multidisciplinary team in an agile environment with an operational ownership mindset (you build it, you run it, you monitor it).

This role requires:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

3–4 years of professional software engineering experience, demonstrating strong backend engineering depth, practical frontend competency, and foundational DevOps capabilities.

Backend Expertise: Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating production microservices and APIs using modern languages such as Java, Node.js, or Go.

Data & Storage: Solid understanding of database design, query optimization, and trade-offs across relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL/document datastores.

Frontend Competence: Practical ability to build, modify, and consume APIs within modern web applications using React, TypeScript, and HTML5/CSS3.

DevOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar), and foundational cloud architecture (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Core Fundamentals: Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, concurrency, object-oriented/functional design) and a disciplined approach to automated testing.

Collaboration: Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to participate in architectural reviews and partner effectively across cross-functional engineering teams.

title: Software Engineer II
text:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

Agents and automations are only as good as the data they can reach. Data Fabric is UiPath’s unified data layer: it models and stores business data, federates data from external enterprise systems without copying it, and makes it available wherever it’s needed across UiPath.
We are looking for a Software Engineer II to build core parts of Data Fabric platform. Backend expertise is a must, and full stack experience is a plus. You will spend most of your time on services, APIs, and platform capabilities, and also contribute to the web experiences customers use.
At UiPath, we are tackling exciting challenges at the intersection of AI and intelligent agents. If you want to be part of it, we’d love to hear from you.




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Passion for Building Scalable Solutions: Demonstrated ability to produce robust, well-tested, high-quality code while adhering to best practices in software development. Monitor what you ship in production, debug cross-service issues, and help resolve incidents.

 - Ownership and customer focus: Own your features from design to production, with guidance on larger designs. Keep the customer experience at the center of what you build.

 - Drive AI innovation: Build platform capabilities that let AI agents and automations discover and use business data through Data Fabric.

 - Backend and distributed systems: Design, build, and optimize scalable, secure services and APIs for the large-scale, multi-tenant Data Fabric platform, with a focus on performance, reliability, and high availability.

 - Contribute to the user experience: Build and improve web UI in Angular or React with TypeScript, and connect it to the backend services you build.

 - Team Collaboration: Work well in agile teams, contribute towards team alignment, and foster a collaborative environment where ideas and knowledge are freely exchanged.

 - Use AI tools well: Use AI tools and coding agents for development (for example, code generation, testing, debugging, and documentation), while keeping a high engineering quality bar.

 - Effective Communication Skills: Clearly articulate technical ideas, design decisions, and solutions to diverse audiences in both written and verbal formats while driving consensus.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

 - 3 to 5 years of software engineering experience building backend or full stack production services.

 - Strong skills in a backend language such as C# (.NET) or Java, and a willingness to learn new ones.

 - A builder's mindset and a bias for action: you take initiative, turn ideas into working software quickly, and stay comfortable with ambiguity.

 - Curiosity about how AI is reshaping software development and the systems we build.

 - Solid grasp of object-oriented programming, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, multithreading, asynchronous programming, and system design basics.

 - Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including schema design and query performance.

 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

 - Familiarity with CI/CD, agile development, and writing automated tests.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with globally distributed teams.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with front-end development using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with React or Angular.
